name: raycast-cli-agent
title: Cli Agent
description: Ask, chat, translate and rewrite selected text using your locally configured Codex or Pi Agent CLI.
author: Carol White

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Ask a question and get a streamed answer. Works as a fallback command.

commands.name: ask-selection
commands.title: Ask About Selection
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Ask a question about the selected text.

commands.name: ask-files
commands.title: Ask About Finder Selection
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Ask a question about the files or folders selected in Finder. The model can read them, nothing else.

commands.name: fix-grammar
commands.title: Fix Spelling and Grammar
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Fix spelling and grammar in the selected text and paste it back.

commands.name: improve-writing
commands.title: Improve Writing
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Make the selected text clearer and paste it back.

commands.name: make-shorter
commands.title: Make Shorter
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Shorten the selected text and paste it back.

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Translate as you type; selected text is filled in. The target language is remembered.

commands.name: translate-replace
commands.title: Translate and Replace
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Translate the selected text into the last used language and paste it back.

commands.name: explain
commands.title: Explain
commands.subtitle: Cli Agent
commands.description: Explain the selected text or code.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Use the CLI's local model and provider configuration, or choose a model in Chat, Translate or on an answer.

preferences.name: primaryLanguage
preferences.title: Primary Language
preferences.description: Your main language. Summaries and explanations of selected text are written in it, and Translate's Auto mode translates into it.

preferences.name: secondaryLanguage
preferences.title: Secondary Language
preferences.description: Translate's Auto mode translates text that is already in your primary language into this one.

preferences.name: webSearch
preferences.title: Web Search
preferences.label: Search the web in Ask AI and Chat
preferences.description: Enable native web search for Codex. Pi has no built-in web search in this extension.

preferences.name: chatTools
preferences.title: Tools
preferences.label: Let Ask AI and Chat read files and propose shell commands
preferences.description: Read files and propose shell commands. Mutations run only after you approve the displayed command.

preferences.name: effort
preferences.title: Reasoning Effort
preferences.description: How hard the model thinks. Higher is slower; short questions rarely need it. Change it in a chat with ⌘⇧E.

preferences.name: customModels
preferences.title: Extra Models
preferences.description: Comma-separated models: codex:model-id or pi:provider/model-id. Unprefixed names are treated as Codex models.

preferences.name: piPath
preferences.title: Pi CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to find pi on your login shell PATH, Homebrew, ~/.local/bin or npm.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to find codex on your login shell PATH, Homebrew, npm or inside the Codex/ChatGPT app.

preferences.name: codexHome
preferences.title: Codex Configuration Directory
preferences.description: Optional CODEX_HOME override. Otherwise use the login shell environment or ~/.codex, including config.toml and existing authentication.

preferences.name: piAgentDir
preferences.title: Pi Configuration Directory
preferences.description: Optional PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR override. Otherwise use the login shell environment or ~/.pi/agent, including settings.json, models.json and auth.json.

preferences.name: extraInstructions
preferences.title: Extra Instructions
preferences.description: Appended to the system prompt of every request (tone, how to address you, etc.).
